MathsNMe helps students build confidence, calculation speed, and mathematical thinking through Vedic Maths, IB Maths, and structured problem-solving practice.
Have a question about MathsNMe, learning paths, or student support?

MathsNMe Learning Policy: Students must complete at least 60 minutes of practice each week, spread across a minimum of 2 – 3 sessions. Missed daily practice may be made up on another day. Failure to meet the weekly requirement may result in a payment requirement and temporary restriction of platform access until the requirement is resolved. Continued lack of participation or progress may result in account review and removal. MathsNMe supports Vedic Maths, IB Maths, and problem-solving skills; it does not guarantee improvement in school examination marks. Olympiad access is available only after at least one year of active learning and is based on the student’s performance and readiness. By using MathsNMe, students and parents/guardians agree to these policies.
